messages.subject: Invalid links for SPDE-tutorial
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm a very very beginner in this world of analysis and am in the process of learning INLA for my thesis (I know, it's quite the challenge). I've been making use of the tutorial found here: http://www.r-inla.org/examples/tutorials/spde-tutorial. However, none of the links to the datasets for the sample problems seem to be working.

For example, here's one for section 2.1:
http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/r-inla.org/ tutorials/spde/R/spde-tutorial-rain.R

Does anyone know where I can find the correct links or datasets for this tutorial?

Thanks!
